clause.title: Platform-confirmed arrival and waiting
clause.rule: Where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and trip_record.events carries the platform's own arrival event stating its geofence test (the distance to the pickup point and the speed at the arrival time), together with wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events, those events are PLATFORM_TELEMETRY records of the platform's full-resolution measurement. They are a carrier independent of the exported gps_trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) and for POL-GEN-02(2): arrival is established at the arrival event's time, and the free waiting period is established as served when wait_timer_expired precedes the termination, unless an admissible fix in the exported trace affirmatively places the driver outside the arrival radius, or moving at 15 km/h or more, during the window (POL-NS-05). A sparse or accuracy-less export trace does not impair these events; it is weighed only for contradiction. A driver-pressed arrival marker (BUTTON) is not covered by this clause. This clause licenses no ruling value.
clause.notes: Added because an exported gps_trace can be sparse, with fixes minutes apart, and report no horizontal accuracy, so the consecutive-fix test of POL-NS-02 cannot be run on it even when the platform itself confirmed the arrival from its own full-resolution stream. The platform's arrival and wait-timer events are its own measurement, not a copy of the export; treating them as the same carrier would send every such case to review although nothing in the record contradicts the platform. The clause covers only platform-confirmed (GPS_AUTO) arrival; a driver-pressed marker remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05.
